notes: τοῖς … ὄχλοις is exactly rule 31's preceding-article case: the article keeps to the, the participle keeps the relativizer, and the noun stands bare — the τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν … ἀδελφοῖς shape.
s016 likewise precedes the expressed ὀργῆς and keeps the, the participle taking the postposed to come discontinuously under rule 15.
s009 is anarthrous, so the supplied Ye is a rule 7 helper on the noun under rule 89's anarthrous arm.
